answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 353 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the vine challenge, the yarrow audit can replay the vertex history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1583 identities would post 794 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
